assumptions: One horizontal x slide; world X forward, Y left, Z up; SI units.
Constant generalized inertia; direct stateless unit-gain gear-one motor with bounded force.
No longitudinal gravity, damping, friction loss, springs, external force or active constraints before contact.
Aligned overlapping wall/bumper boxes; clearance is near wall face minus front bumper surface.
Euler with no damping: velocity advances before position; commands held for one timestep.
Predictive bounds apply only before contact and for forward non-reversing stopping; recovery is unsupported.
No nonzero uncertainty is certified; sampled evidence does not prove continuous real-hardware safety.
analytical_feasibility.claim_scope: task existence in the supported discrete analytical model; not controller safety

equations.delay: r=ceil(tau/h); delay_distance=v*r*h; no second implicit reaction interval

braking_work_magnitude.method: Sum generalized_force[k]*(position[k+1]-position[k]); left-held force, final unadvanced command excluded. Magnitude of negative interval contributions.

clearance_safety_margin.method: Minimum sampled gap minus required gap.

command_saturation_duration.method: Time requested input is at or beyond a compiled control clamp; distinct from applied force.

contact_episodes.method: Rising edges of actual wall-collision signal.

electrical_energy.reason: No electrical signals or motor efficiency model.

force_saturation_duration.method: Time at effective generalized-force clamps in supported direct motor; excludes final sample.

force_saturation_fraction.method: Saturation duration divided by measured interval duration.

peak_absolute_jerk.method: Difference of adjacent interval accelerations over midpoint separation; no endpoint padding, no damage inference.

peak_deceleration.method: Maximum negative longitudinal forward-difference acceleration; may include contact forces.

positive_mechanical_work.method: Sum generalized_force[k]*(position[k+1]-position[k]); left-held force, final unadvanced command excluded. Positive interval contributions.

signed_mechanical_work.method: Sum generalized_force[k]*(position[k+1]-position[k]); left-held force, final unadvanced command excluded.

time_after_last_braking.method: Measured remaining horizon after last negative-force interval.

travel_after_last_braking.method: Signed measured position change after the last negative-force integration interval; exposes residual coasting, not a safety proof.

uncertainty: No nonzero parameter uncertainty certified.
No global source-program safety proof.
Predictive model excludes soft contact and reverse recovery.
Recorded A/B/C success is not a guarantee for untested parameters or real hardware.
